title: RPM (Red Hat Package Manager) signature
summary: An RPM package begins with the 4-byte magic 0xED 0xAB 0xEE 0xDB followed by a 4-byte version (0x00030000 for RPM v3, 0x00040000 for v4).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: RPM uses cpio archive format with a lead, signature header, and header.
RPM is the package format for RHEL, Fedora, CentOS, openSUSE, etc.
